title: Locally split coordinate short exact sequence on polynomial Proj
statement: Let $k$ be a field and $P=\operatorname{Proj} k[x_0,x_1]$ with its standard grading [def-sc-p1-standard]. Let $G$ be any $\mathcal O_P$-module and $z\in\mathbf Z$. Put $G(d)=G\otimes\mathcal O_P(d)$, with twists as in [def-weil-pbc-proj-twisting-sheaf]. Let $\mu_i:G(z)\to G(z+1)$ be $G$ whiskered with Proj.twistMul by $x_i$. There exists $f:G(z-1)\to G(z)\oplus G(z)$ such that $0\to G(z-1)\xrightarrow{f}G(z)\oplus G(z)\xrightarrow{(\mu_0,\mu_1)}G(z+1)\to0$ is short exact. The direct sum is the categorical binary biproduct. No coherence or flatness of $G$ is assumed.

proof.text: Obtain f, its zero composite, and the limiting kernel fork from the kernel-fork lemma. Its universal property gives Mono f and ShortComplex.exact_of_f_is_kernel gives exactness. The proved quotient-epi lemma gives Epi g. Combine them with ShortComplex.ShortExact.mk'.

theorem exists_proj_coordinate_shortExact
    (k : Type u) [Field k]
    (G : (Proj (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k)).Modules) (z : ℤ) :
    ∃ (f : G ⊗ Proj.twist (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k) (z - 1) ⟶
        (G ⊗ Proj.twist (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k) z) ⊞
        (G ⊗ Proj.twist (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k) z))
      (h : f ≫ biprod.desc
        (G ◁ Proj.twistMul z (MvPolynomial.X_mem_homogeneousSubmodule_one k (0 : Fin 2)))
        (G ◁ Proj.twistMul z (MvPolynomial.X_mem_homogeneousSubmodule_one k (1 : Fin 2))) = 0),
      (ShortComplex.mk f (biprod.desc
        (G ◁ Proj.twistMul z (MvPolynomial.X_mem_homogeneousSubmodule_one k (0 : Fin 2)))
        (G ◁ Proj.twistMul z (MvPolynomial.X_mem_homogeneousSubmodule_one k (1 : Fin 2))))
        h).ShortExact
